The '''Virtual Sets (2002-2009)''' (also called '''pre-reorg Virtual Sets''') were the original numbered Virtual Sets released by the [[Players Committee]] from 2002 until the September 2009 reorganization into Virtual Blocks. They were printable PDF game-text slips that players sleeved over Decipher cards.<ref name="tfn2002">[https://theforce.net/ccg/story/Players_Committee_Announces_the_First_Virtual_Card_Set_68946.asp Player's Committee Announces the First Virtual Card Set], TheForce.Net, 12 February 2002 (citing Game Players Network)</ref> They began as a pilot program to revive underused cards and strengthen storyline play.

They are distinct from the later [[:Category:Virtual Legacy sets|Virtual Block]] hubs and from the post-2014 [[:Category:Current Virtual sets|Current Virtual]] pool. Early slips used a modifier framing very different from the later Block presentation. Current Virtual slanted-ring sets after the 2014 Reset differ again.

== How early Virtual worked ==

* Virtual cards were distributed as '''PDF slips''' to print and insert in opaque sleeves with the matching Decipher card.<ref name="tfn2002" /><ref name="decivs1">[https://web.archive.org/web/20020610072829/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/playerscommittee/virtualcardset1.html Virtual Card Set #1 is Away!], decipher.com (Wayback, 10 June 2002 snapshot; dated 5 March 2002)</ref>
* Virtual versions were marked with '''(V)''' in rulings, articles, and deck lists.<ref name="decivs1" />
* Players could include both the original Decipher text and the (V) version in a deck, but could not switch a card either way once a tournament began.<ref name="decivs1" />
* The Set 1 slips survive as VirtualCards1.pdf, with the early modifier framing, and VirtualCards1a.pdf.<ref name="vc1pdf">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050813215254/http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/virtual/VirtualCards1.pdf VirtualCards1.pdf], decipher.com virtual cardlists (Wayback)</ref><ref name="vc1apdf">[https://web.archive.org/web/20070117223920/http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/virtual/VirtualCards1a.pdf VirtualCards1a.pdf], decipher.com (Wayback)</ref>

== After September 2009: Blocks ==

'''Fifth Anthology''' was previewed on 8 June 2009 as the 18th Virtual Set<ref name="plfifth">[https://star-wars.pl/News/10466,Preview_Fifth_Anthology.html Preview Fifth Anthology], star-wars.pl, 8 June 2009</ref> but was never published as its own slip PDF. Its preview titles appear in '''Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV''' ([https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf VirtualBlock6_1.pdf], official text 4 September 2009) in [[Virtual Block 6]]. The previewed gametext of Luke Skywalker, Strong In The Force and Maneuvering Flaps & Nick Of Time appears there unchanged. Unlike [[Virtual Set 19: Galaxy At War|Galaxy At War]], it is not listed as unreleased.<ref name="plsets" /> It is not the modern [[Virtual Set 18]] (21 April 2022).

The PC's Virtual Block PDFs (e.g. [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf VirtualBlock1.pdf]) carry official text as of 7 December 2009 and state: "Since the reorganization of the previous 18 virtual sets, there are now six blocks structured by theme..."<ref name="blockreorg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf VirtualBlock1.pdf] (same blurb on VirtualBlock2-5.pdf)</ref>

The PC slips library lists '''Legacy Virtual Sets (2002-2009)''' separately from '''Legacy Virtual Blocks (2009-2014)''', whose hubs run from [[Virtual Block 1]] to [[Virtual Block 9]] plus [[Virtual Shields]].<ref name="slips">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/virtual-slips/ Virtual Slips / Files], starwarsccg.org (Legacy Sets vs Blocks headings)</ref>

The old Virtual Set PDFs remain historical printings, and Block packaging is a later layer for the pre-Reset pool. Current Virtual, from [[Virtual Set 0]] and the 24 September 2014 Reset, is a third era for tournament Standard play.

Cards could be '''errata'd''' or '''dropped''' from the legal pool between eras. [[Formats]] distinguishes '''Legacy''' (pre-Reset virtual pool) from '''Standard''' (post-Reset). Rules documents likewise version by era: Decipher core books, [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0|Advanced Rulebook 2.0]] (Legacy Virtual-era), and the current [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook]] (2023).
